item.title: Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni reportedly knew Phia was ‘cookie stuffing’ for months
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Phia, the shopping startup co-founded by Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, is once again under fire for its alleged business practices.

item.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The U.S. VC firm still has more than 55% of its previous $650 million India fund available for deployment.

item.title: Uber surprised robotics company Serve by selling its entire stake
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The divestiture comes as the two once-tight companies have started to diverge on the business side.

item.title: FBI says cybercriminals are hacking into victims’ online accounts to steal their intimate pictures
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: In a new alert, the FBI said cybercriminals are targeting adults and minors in an attempt to steal their personal and intimate pictures in extortion campaigns.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

item.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Google also shared numbers of how people are actually using the chatbot, with 63% of Gemini users talking directly to the assistant using the voice feature. Plus, Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to Google.

item.title: Bluesky’s active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Over a year following its post-election surge, Bluesky’s mobile app is seeing a continued decline in active users, though its remaining community is still relatively engaged.

item.title: What’s Scaleup Europe, the $5.7B fund that just backed satellite company ICEYE?
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Scaleup Europe, a public-private fund with a $5.7 billion target, made its first investment by backing Finnish satellite company ICEYE.

item.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."

item.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.

item.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

item.title: Joby Aviation builds out defense business with $500M acquisition
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Joby Aviation reached an agreement to acquire Resonant Sciences, which will kick off its new defense business.

item.title: Delta investigating after someone set up fake Wi-Fi network mid-flight
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: The Delta flight crew switched off the aircraft's legitimate Wi-Fi network for around 30 minutes due to the incident, according to a spokesperson.

item.title: Block Blast! goes ad-free on Apple Arcade
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Block Blast!, the most downloaded mobile game of 2025, is coming to Apple Arcade in September, where it will be ad-free.

item.title: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe is betting on EVs, robots, and autonomy all at once — he’ll explain why at Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Rivian's CEO RJ Scaringe is speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to detail his journey, and the lessons it’s bestowed.

item.title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation prediction markets
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: FlightAware says that Kalshi used its name and data to offer bets on flight cancellations without the flight tracker's permission.

item.title: Kyoto Fusioneering starts work on key fusion power plant device
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Fusion power startups are turning to Kyoto Fusioneering to supply components for future power plants. The Japan-based startup just received a grant to build a part of the fuel system.

item.title: Bumble ditches its rule that kept men from making the first move
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Bumble is ditching the rule that it has enforced since launching in 2024. Men can finally message first.

item.title: North Korean remote IT staffer worked for US government agency, says FBI
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The investigation shows that North Koreans are able to infiltrate government agencies, as well as private organizations and crypto exchanges.

item.title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.
